title: Death Threat
plot_source_plaintext:
Things are thrown into an uproar when Harry receives a threat via a rock thrown through the window and a bomb is discovered in the courtroom.

Note: Phil Leeds appears as a man claiming to be God. George Murdock appears as a homicide detective. Jack Murdock appears as a bomb defuser.
